data.action: 在书架间被画面外同伴搂住，双臂环住对方脖颈，白裙自然堆叠。
data.description: 旧书库无人经过的书架深处，未花被你温柔地搂在怀中，纯白的裙摆轻轻堆叠。她紧紧环住你的脖颈，粉发散落在你的肩头，金瞳泛着迷离的水光——「老师……不要离开我……把未花抱得再紧一点……好不好？」
data.nsfwProse: She wears her sleeveless white tea-party ballgown with gold embroidery, draped white silk shawl, evening gloves, and white tights gathered closely between the shelves.
data.promptProse: Tucked between the towering shelves of Trinity's restricted library late at night, Mika wraps her gloved arms around her partner's neck with wings folded close and her sleeveless gold-embroidered white ballgown gathered softly between them. Dim candlelight touches her flushed cheeks in an intimate first-person view.
data.title: 圣园未花 · 书架深处的禁忌拥抱
data.animaCaption: Pressed close between the dark library stacks, she loops her white-gloved arms around her partner's neck with folded wings and a tender blush as her gold-embroidered white ballgown gathers against them. Dim candlelight warms the narrow aisle.
